stock.description: Luyuan Group Holding (Cayman) Limited, operating through its subsidiaries, specializes in the entire process of designing, researching, developing, manufacturing, and selling electric two-wheeled vehicles within the People's Republic of China. Its product portfolio spans various electric two-wheelers, including motorcycles, mopeds, and bicycles, alongside purpose-built vehicles, batteries, and essential vehicle components. The firm, founded in 2003, maintains its corporate headquarters in Jinhua, China.
